'''Fort Dandunc''' was an estate used by the [[Qunaalac]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kor Qunaalac]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fort was one of the planet's most well known residences and was sited next to an artificial lake, on top of a round hill. The fort had significant ground and air defences and housed Qunaalac treasures and war trophies.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
